appearance_facts.location: A single blue line spans the plot from the left edge to the right edge.
appearance_facts.fact: The line starts low on the left, rises steadily to a peak near the right, then dips slightly at the final point.

appearance_facts.location: The line's lowest point is at the far left (1880) and its highest point is near the far right (1890).
appearance_facts.fact: The overall shape is an upward trend with a small drop only at the very end.

appearance_facts.location: Between 1882 and 1884 the line shows a small local dip and then resumes rising.
appearance_facts.fact: There is a minor plateau/dip in the early-middle section, but the long-term direction is upward.

appearance_facts.location: The line reaches its maximum height at the second-to-last x-position (1890).
appearance_facts.fact: The peak value is visually the highest point on the chart, above the 3,000 gridline.

appearance_facts.location: The final segment (1890 to 1891) slopes downward.
appearance_facts.fact: Only the last year shows a decrease, dropping from the peak but still remaining near the top of the chart.
